nodes.title: Atoms, particulate nature & composition
nodes.mechanism: matter is composed of discrete particles whose identity and count fix its behaviour

nodes.title: Chemical amount / the mole
nodes.mechanism: a counting convention that bridges particulate count to macroscopic mass, volume and charge

nodes.title: Periodicity
nodes.mechanism: recurring electronic configuration produces recurring property trends

nodes.title: Bonding & molecular structure
nodes.mechanism: electrons are shared or transferred between nuclei to lower total energy

nodes.title: Structure–property relationships
nodes.mechanism: spatial and electronic arrangement determines observable property

nodes.title: Interparticle interactions, states & solutions
nodes.mechanism: attraction between particles competes with thermal motion

nodes.title: Chemical change & reaction mechanisms
nodes.mechanism: bonds break and form along a pathway that conserves atoms and charge

nodes.title: Electrochemistry
nodes.mechanism: redox driven or resisted by an electrical potential difference

nodes.title: Redox
nodes.mechanism: electrons transfer between species, changing oxidation state

nodes.title: Reaction stoichiometry
nodes.mechanism: balanced equations fix mole ratios between species

nodes.title: Energy & thermodynamics
nodes.mechanism: energy is conserved and redistributed; spontaneity is set by free energy

nodes.title: Equilibrium
nodes.mechanism: opposing processes reach equal rates, fixing a state ratio

nodes.title: Solubility equilibria
nodes.mechanism: dissolution and precipitation reach equal rates

nodes.title: Kinetics
nodes.mechanism: rate is governed by the barrier and the frequency of effective encounters
